title: MethylC-seq using EZ DNA Methylation-Gold Bisulfite and Accel-NGS DNA Library Kits
author: Diep R R Ganguly
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.p88drzw
materials: 1. Perform gDNA extraction using method of choice. For example, CTAB can give decent quality gDNA. The DNeasy Plant Mini Kit from Qiagen gives really high-quality plant gDNA, however, yields can be quite low. 2. Run gDNA on a 1% agarose gel to make sure there are no contaminants (e.g. CTAB extraction can leave a large amount of sheared nucleic material) nor degradation.
Quantify sheared gDNA samples using Qubit.
as per their manual (see attached PDF).

steps.title: Normalize and Shear gDNA
steps.instruction: Normalize gDNA samples to the desired amount (typically 0.5 - 1 µg) and shear using a Covaris ultrasonicator to obtain a smear from 200bp - 500bp (peak ~300bp).

substeps.instruction: Use Covaris settings: 1 x 60 sec cycle; Duty 10%, intensity 5, cycles/burst 200

steps.title: Quality Control and Cleanup of Sheared DNA
steps.instruction: Verify the obtained smear and optionally clean the sample.

substeps.instruction: Run on agarose gel or LabChip GX to QC the smear.
Optional: Use SPRI select beads to remove fragments <110bp using a 0.8X ratio of SPRI to sample, or perform a right-side cleanup for larger fragments.
Quantify sheared gDNA samples using Qubit.

steps.title: Perform Bisulfite Conversion
steps.instruction: Convert a 20µl aliquot of the sheared gDNA using the EZ DNA Methylation-Gold Kit (D5005/D5006) according to the manufacturer's manual.

substeps.instruction: Ensure the CT conversion reagent is fresh (stored at -20C for no more than 1 month).

steps.title: Prepare NGS Library
steps.instruction: Prepare a next-generation sequencing library using the Accel-NGS Manual with a normalized input of 100 - 200 ng of converted DNA.

substeps.instruction: Plan indexing combinations using the Methyl-Seq Set A Indexing Kit (Illumina TruSeq indexing adapters) prior to PCR amplification to facilitate demultiplexing.
Use full reaction volumes (though 1/2 volumes have been tested as reliable).
Limit PCR cycling to 6 - 8 cycles, aiming for a final library molarity of ~ 8nM.

steps.title: Library Quality Control and Quantification
steps.instruction: Perform quality control on final libraries to check fragment size distribution and quantify molarity.

substeps.instruction: Use a bioanalyser or LabChip GX/GXII for size distribution.
Determine library molarity using the most abundant molecule size, assuming an average molecular weight of 650 g/mol per double-stranded DNA base-pair.

steps.title: Pool Libraries for Sequencing
steps.instruction: Pool high-quality libraries into an equal-molar sample based on the requirements of the sequencing facility.

substeps.instruction: Aim for 2nM in 15ul using Tris/TE pH 8-8.5.
Retain aliquots of each individual library until data is generated, screened, and backed-up.
